note: Cross County has no public GIS or zoning service. The county site links no zoning. Wynne, the county seat and largest city, publishes its City Zoning Map only as a PDF (Map_1_legacy_import.pdf) and its regulations as PDF; no queryable zoning polygons were found. Cherry Valley's zoning districts map is a PDF inside a state annexation file. Parkin, Hughes (St. Francis County) and Vanndale were searched without any zoning service found. Third-party parcel portals (equatorstudios, Rockford Map) are commercial downloads, not official services.
